rows.claim: “As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.” must be clearly and prominently stated on the site (or a substantially similar statement).
rows.source_label: Operating Agreement §5 (Identifying Yourself as an Associate), updated Oct 15, 2025

rows.topic: Special Links must carry the Associates ID
rows.claim: Special Links must include the Associates ID or “tag” (appearing as XXXXX-##, or another format Amazon designates) as a URL parameter.
rows.source_label: Program Policies, Participation Requirements §2(b), updated Apr 14, 2026

rows.claim: Policy example format is XXXXX-##. The selected tracking ID is shopnow047c-20 (11-character prefix). Format acceptance is not confirmed from the policy text.

rows.topic: Prices may only be displayed under conditions
rows.claim: Price and availability may be shown only if Amazon serves the link displaying them, or the data comes via Creators API / PA-API under its License.
rows.used_on: Product table: price fields left blank

rows.topic: Links that are not properly formatted disqualify purchases
rows.claim: Purchases are disqualified if they are not correctly tracked because links are not properly formatted; purchases via a Redirecting Link (indirect, no click on the intermediate site) are disqualified.
rows.source_label: Program Policies, Commission Income Statement §2(e) and §2(g)

rows.topic: Links generated on search engines are excluded
rows.claim: Purchases by customers referred by a link generated or displayed on a search engine (including sponsored placements) are disqualified.
rows.used_on: Growth plan (SEO) — noted, not an exclusion of organic search traffic

rows.topic: Paid search keywords containing Amazon marks
rows.claim: Purchases referred via ads bought on keywords including “amazon” or “kindle” (or misspellings) are disqualified.
rows.used_on: Campaign ledger rules (no paid search planned)

rows.topic: Domain names must not include Amazon trademarks
rows.claim: Domain names, subdomains and tags must not include an Amazon trademark or misspelling.
rows.used_on: Site name “Crisp & Done” contains no Amazon mark (checked against the cited list only; see FLG-009)

rows.claim: Disclose any financial relationship with a brand; placement must be hard to miss and placed with the endorsement itself, not only on an About/profile page or below the fold.
rows.source_label: FTC, Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers (Nov 2019)
rows.used_on: Disclosure strip under masthead on every page; repeated in footer

rows.claim: You can’t talk about experience with a product you haven’t tried, and can’t make claims that require proof the advertiser doesn’t have.
rows.source_label: FTC, Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers, “What Else to Know”
rows.used_on: Guides: no product performance claims; only listing text is quoted

rows.topic: Only Amazon Associates text may be used for commission-related claims
rows.claim: Commission rates are set in the Associates rate schedule. The schedule page redirected to sign-in when fetched.
rows.source_label: Associates Program — Standard Commission Income schedule (sign-in required)

rows.claim: Observed product URLs use /dp/<ASIN>; the five observed ASINs are 10 alphanumeric characters. An official Amazon definition page was not located in this session.
rows.source_label: Observed on Amazon.com product page (P-01); same pattern on P-02..P-05 (see products.json)

rows.claim: Each supplied link path token is 9 characters. Each redirects to a different 10-character ASIN.
rows.source_label: Supplied short link P-01 (redirect followed); P-02..P-05 tokens are in products.json

rows.topic: GitHub Pages publishing via custom Actions workflow
rows.claim: A site can be published by selecting GitHub Actions as the Pages source; the workflow deploys the uploaded artifact.
rows.source_label: GitHub Docs — Configuring a publishing source for GitHub Pages

rows.claim: Usage example: uses actions/deploy-pages@v4 after actions/upload-pages-artifact.
